notes.title: What's new on the Goblinz side?
notes.content:
Hello Goblinz,

We have a lot of news lately, so we thought it would be really cool to give you a little summary here!

As you probably know, Goblinz is focused on strategy and management games, and we strive to offer you high-quality games with our selection.

We regularly offer demos so you can get hands-on experience before buying!

[h2]Synergy[/h2]
Today, Synergy is being released, a beautiful city builder inspired by Pharaoh and Frostpunk. The game is developed by Leikir Studio and you will have 10% off the 2 first weeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989070/Synergy/?snr=1_1056_4_creator_1057&curator_clanid=33025551

[h2]
The Executive[/h2]
Last week, we announced a new game: The Executive, a Tycoon set in the film industry.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2315430/The_Executive__A_Movie_Industry_Tycoon/?snr=1_1056_4_creator_1057&curator_clanid=33025551

[h2]
Sandwalkers[/h2]
Sandwalkers will have a new prologue, this time focusing on gameplay rather than the story. It will be released on June 4th. And we can already announce that Sandwalkers will be available in Early Access before this summer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2995230/Sandwalkers__Prologue/?snr=1_1056_ajaxgetfilteredrecommendations_creator_curator-tabs&curator_clanid=33025551

[h2]
Mini Settlers[/h2]
The demo of Mini Settlers is a huge hit with more than 80,000 players in the last three weeks! If you haven't tried it yet, you can find it here. Mini Settlers is an automation game similar to Factorio but much simpler, like Mini Metro.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521630/Mini_Settlers/?snr=1_1056_ajaxgetfilteredrecommendations_creator_curator-tabs&curator_clanid=33025551

Last but not least, Fantastic Haven will be at the Steam Next Fest in June! If you want to join the private beta, head over to Discord:
https://discord.gg/goblinzstudio

Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2556470/Fantastic_Haven/?snr=1_1056_ajaxgetfilteredrecommendations_creator_curator-tabs&curator_clanid=33025551

Other minor news:
[list]
[*] The new update for Hero's Hour is currently in open beta
[*] A new update for Racine is coming
[*] Fantastic Haven will have a prologue too!
[/list]

See you soon Goblinz!

notes.title: Big announcements for Goblinz 5th Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today is a special day for Goblinz, as the studio is already celebrating its 5th anniversary!
For the past 5 years, we have been developing and publishing games we believe in. It's been quite an adventure, but this is just the beginning!

For the occasion, we have surprises for you including new games announcement and big sales on all our games!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/goblinz_publishing/sale/publishersale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/031edc7df8b0e2ab9136d7024a38b2fa14a2f260.png[/img][/url]

[h1]New published games: Diluvian Winds & Defend the Rook[/h1]

We are so excited to announce the addition of [b]Diluvian Winds[/b] and[b] Defend the Rook[/b] in the Goblinz catalogue!

[b]Diluvian Winds[/b] is a [b]sail punk city builder[/b] developed by [b]Alambik Studio[/b].
In a context of exile due to the rising waters, survive as you expand your community in your lighthouse!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

[b]Defend the Rook[/b] is a [b]roguelike tactics board combat[/b] combined with [b]tower defense elements[/b] developed by [b]One Up Plus[/b]. 
Defeat the invading hoards to stay alive and save the land! Enjoy more tactics than a normal TD game, combined with the added challenge of building towers and fighting off waves of enemies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1531250/Tactics_Tower_Mayhem/

[b]Add these games to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow Goblinz Publishing on [url=https://twitter.com/GoblinzPub]Twitter[/url][/b] so you don't miss any of their respective news!

[h1]All our games on sale![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/goblinz_publishing/sale/publishersale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/caeb0d87afbf73cbe1e9b8c5f13bdc6393ea3d1b.png[/img][/url]

Take part in our publisher sale and save up to 90% on our games until March 25th!
From Legend of Keepers to As Far As The Eye or the recently released ski resort tycoon Snowtopia, it's more than ever time to get the Goblinz games!

[b]Check out our sale page[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/goblinz_publishing/sale/publishersale]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/goblinz_publishing/sale/publishersale[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253860/Neurodeck__Psychological_Deckbuilder/#app_reviews_hash

And don't hesitate to join us on Discord if you haven't already: [url=https://discord.com/invite/goblinzstudio]https://discord.com/invite/goblinzstudio[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Neverending Tower
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v1.2.0.png[/img]

We have worked hard to enhance the game experience based on your feedbacks and reports. This patch note contains a brand new game mode, characters balance, skins available as a DLC as well as some modifications to make the Arena mode more attractive and Portuguese localization!

You can find a Deluxe Edition bundle containing the Soundtrack, Wallpapers and the Skins pack [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2403/]here[/url] with -15% off if you already own the game! 

Thank you all for your support!

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] New mode available on the Campaign Map: The Neverending Tower! Plunder its floors to drop blueprints, items, potions and resources and try to finish the highest possible level! (unlocked at the end of 1st theme - drops and enemies are scaled to your current highest theme unlocked)
[*] New Steam leaderboards for the Neverending Tower feature!
[*] New pack containing 1 skin for each playable character available as a DLC!
[*] You can now share your exploration replay on social networks!
[*] Portuguese localization is now available!
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
[*] Dungeon limits have been increased for Arena mode to make multiplayer dungeons more difficult
[*] Matchmaking has been improved by increasing the points range when looking for an opponent. Players will now be able to face opponents from a higher or lower league if an opponent of the same league can’t be found
[*] ELO system for Arena mode has been reworked: Losing a match will now give points to the defending player and the attacking player will lose points as usual. Winning a match will now make the defending player lose points and the attacking player will win points as usual. The number of points won or lost are now depending on the difference of points between the two players 
[*] Skeleton Warriors’ experience earned when killed has been increased
[/list]

[H1] Characters balance [/H1]
[list] 
[*] Pod:

[list]
[*] Shrilling Threnody base damage has been reduced from 1 to 0
[*] Shrilling Threnody base mana burst has been increased from 0 to 1
[*] A stamina cost increase of 1 has been added to the Lullaby talent
[*] Spiritual Ballad base mana regen has been reduced from 25% to 20%
[*] Mana regen bonus granted by the Spiritual Ballad talent has been reduced from +25% to +20%
[/list]

[*] Melinda:

[list]
[*] Laceration damage scaling with strength has been increased
[*] Laceration base damage has been increased from 0 to 1
[*] Laceration no longer needs a line of sight to be used
[*] Laceration base mana cost has been increased from 1 to 2
[*] Slash damage scaling with strength has been slightly reduced
[*] Life recovery from the passive ability Blood Drinker when killing an enemy has been reduced from 20% to 10%
[/list]

[*] Trashkarog:

[list]
[*] Wolf Attack base damage has been increased from 0 to 1
[*] Explosive Potion damage scaling with magical power has been slightly increased
[*] Explosive Potion base chance to apply Burn has been increased from 15% to 20%
[*] Bonus chance to apply Burn from the Explosive Potion talent has been increased from +15% to +20% per level
[*] Orc Curse is now dealing small damage in addition to its previous effects
[*] Additional mana cost from the Orc Curse talent which allows the skill to target all enemies instead of a line has been increased from 1 to 2
[*] Bait base stamina cost has been reduced from 5 to 4
[/list]

[*] Rose:

[list]
[*] Disease base damage per turn has been increased from 1 to 2
[*] Disease base duration has been reduced from 3 to 2 turns
[/list]

[*] Odessa:

[list]
[*] War Cry base stamina cost has been reduced from 5 to 4
[/list]

[*] Franck:

[list]
[*] Shoots damage are now physical damage and are scaling with strength
[*] Shoots can now be launched on a line of your choice instead of the front line only
[*] Armor and magical resistance from the talent which grants bonuses when a mojo is equipped have been increased from 3 to 5
[*] The talent granting a magical power bonus when using Nature Boon is now granting a strength bonus instead
[*] Mana burst bonus from the Dual Claw talent has been increased from 3 to 4
[*] Chances to apply Poison from Creepers Prison talent has been increased from 25% to 35% per level
[*] Passive mana regen from the passive ability Shapeshifter: Human has been increased from 2 to 3
[*] Passive damage bonus from the passive ability Shapeshifter: Beast has been increased from +15% to +20%
[/list]
		
[*] Anemhutep:

[list]
[*] Soul Absorption base life cost has been reduced from 3 to 1
[*] Strips Explosion base life cost has been reduced from 4 to 3
[*] Mummified base magical resistance debuff has been increased from 10% to 15%
[*] Magical resistance debuff bonus from the Mummified talent has been increased from -10% to -15%
[*] Life Drain life regen per turn has been increased from 2 to 3 at max level
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0: Controller support and new languages!
notes.content:
You’ve asked for it, we did it! Russian, Japanese, Italian and Spanish are now available in Dungeon Rushers as well as controller support!

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] Controller support is now available!
[*] Russian, Japanese, Italian and Spanish localizations are now available!
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
[*] Camera focus on the campaign screen will now automatically match with selected dungeon
[*] Old Arena mode dungeons which are not respecting the new limits are progressively deleted (6 Gorillas groups, containing doors and keys, etc...)
[*] Players using cheat codes in Arena mode will be banned and won’t be able to play in Arena mode anymore
[*] Every item in the game can now be sold without restriction (items you couldn’t sell before have now a confirmation window)
[*] Items are now sorted better in the inventory
[*] Game over screen has been improved to better fit with all types of resolution
[*] An information about camera auto-center has been added in the exploration tutorial screen
[*] Exploration abilities can now be used on groups of monsters containing a boss. Bosses are now immune to additional effects.
[*] The group of 6 monsters just before the chest in dungeon “Oops I dropped traps” has been reduced to 5 monsters
[/list]


[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which was affecting turn order when characters were switching position
[*] Fixed a bug allowing a character to play even if stunned in a specific situation
[*] Fixed a bug in fight history which was displaying an empty indication in french when a monster was revived or summoned
[*] Fixed a bug allowing Anemhutep to use skills with a life cost even when Silenced
[*] Wolf Affliction effect will now correctly display magical resistance debuff animation when applied
[*] Life bars of monsters affected by Odessa’s War Cry are now correctly displaying damage taken when entering the fight
[*] Blueprints label is now correctly displayed on the victory screen when finishing a dungeon in Arena Mode
[*] UI and typo fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Release version 1.0.0 is available!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v1.0.0.png[/img]

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] Last but not least, the 4th theme is now available with around 7 hours of additional gameplay in the desert!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/campaign.png[/img]

[*] New characters to unlock: Anemhutep the Ancient Mummy Dude and Elvire the Crusader of the Light Temple!
[*] As well as 8 new monsters and an unexpected final Boss!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/anem.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/elvire.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/monsters.png[/img]

[*] New fight event: Sand storm - Fighters take small damage at the end of the turn. Each negative effect increases damage taken!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/sand storm.png[/img]

[*] New exploration mechanism: Portals - Where will you be teleported in the dungeon? Who knows...
[*] New Free Mode Dungeon tools: Doors requiring 2 and 3 keys, Magic door requiring a password and Portals!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/Portals.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/Doors.png[/img]

[*] 4 new Heroic only items!
[*] Translation in German and Chinese are now available! (Russian and Japanese translations are already in process)
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
	[*] New font: easier for your eyes to read our humorous story!
[*] Introduction text for each theme has now a displaying animation
	[*] Many UI improvements
	[*] Sounds added for Rose
	[*] Sounds for theme 3 monsters added
	[*] Lots of sounds added for effects and exploration
	[*] Sounds has been equalized and rebalanced with music volume

[/list]

notes.title: Early-Access 0.9.4 is available!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v0.9.4.png[/img]

0.9.4 :
[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] You can now gamble in the shop to use your gold
[*] 5 new super potions available by gambling only
[*] New exploration mechanic (available in the Worksite) : Portals - Instantly teleport you to another portal in the dungeon
[*] New fight event: Sand storm - Every fighters take damage based on the number of debuffs affecting them
[*] UI tweaks
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
[*] New AI system, monsters do better choices when using spells
[*] Ask for a confirmation before deleting a free dungeon
[*] Monsters’ passive skills have now a blue text in the fighter details in fight and in the dungeon creation when editing monsters in a room
[*] Improved warning animation to know where the Collapse will fall
[*] Doesn’t show immunities anymore if monsters are hidden in a bush
[*] UI tweaks
[/list]

[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Fixed performance issue on inventory and workshop
[*] Feedback window is fixed
[*] Fixed a bug where the Collapse event was blocking a fight when it killed the first character in the attack order
[*] Fixed a bug where using “Defend” against Collapse didn’t guarantee a parry
[*] Fixed a bug where players were able to open manor treasures indefinitely
[*] Fixed a bug where equipped items were not displayed properly when opening the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug where the treasure key was missing in some heroic mode dungeons
[*] Fixed a bug where Franck had the passive bonuses from his “Shapeshifter” ability without unlocking it
[*] Fixed a bug where Pod’s Lullaby chances to apply Sleep were inverted
[*] Effects are now well refreshed after a resurrection
[/list]

[H1] Only for closed testers [/H1]
[list]
[*] The begin of Act 4 is available (6 additional dungeons and 1 manor)
[/list]

If you want to become a closed tester you can subscribe here: http://eepurl.com/b_7UlD

notes.title: Early-Access 0.9.3 is available!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v0.9.3.png[/img]

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] End of theme 3 is now available
[*] New Heroic-only items added for theme 3
[*] New fight event: Camouflage - Monsters are hidden in a strange bush, if you want to know what is hiding in it, you’ll have to hit the bush or wait for something to come out of it!
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/bush_screen.png[/img]
[/list]
[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
[*] Items in the inventory are now sorted in addition to the filter
[*] Moving away from a wooden sign in a dungeon will now close it automatically
[*] Beeing Game Over during a fight will now refresh the shop
[*] Talents’ tooltip has been improved to better understand what will be increased when putting a second talent point
[*] Collapse fight event now have a sound and has a better timing
[*] More balancing changes have been made to characters and monsters 
[*] New tutorial page when you first level up
[*] Fight tutorial has been changed to inform players about the characters or monsters details window appearing by right clicking on a fighter
[*] Some dungeons has been made optional in theme 2 and 3 to smoothen the player progression and allow the story to progress faster
[*] Facebook and Twitter buttons added to the menu screen
[*] New animation for monsters summoned
[*] Animation of monsters coming for reinforcement has been reworked
[/list]

[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Pressing two or more shortcuts buttons/mouse clicks at the same time no longer make the game glitch
[*] The dungeon validation bug caused by the “Only one boss” restriction has been fixed
[*] Channeling bugs should now be fixed for monsters concerned
[*] The reinforcement skills “Pygmies!!!” and “Help me!” bug has been fixed and should no longer call for unintended monsters
[*] Fixed a bug in the shop where you were blocked on your inventory second page if you sold the last item of the page
[*] Deleting a tile in the dungeon editor should now also delete the token displayed in it if it was the case
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where monsters’ life bar was not refreshed correctly
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where characters' life bar was not refreshed correctly when healed when attacking (Vampirism effect or Melinda’s Blood Drinker ability)
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where damage previews were not taking count of damage amplifiers like the Stalked effect from Melinda
[/list]
